comment: Cheap variation of the tutorial exit: a debug-mode Valkyrie spends five turns in tut-1 and then picks Dungeons of Doom level 1 from the ^V level-teleport menu. teleport.c level_tele() schedules the move; do.c goto_level() calls nhlua.c tutorial(FALSE), whose nhlib.lua tutorial_leave() prints "Resetting time to move #1." and restores the saved inventory and worn armor through nhl_gamestate(TRUE).
